Callout.Name: Overweight Lorry
Callout.Message: Lorry stopped for a weight check, driver abusive.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle on the weighbridge, driver out of the cab.

Script.Line: He failed the weight check and he was not polite about it.
I have got him stopped and he is arguing with me about the paperwork.
I need a second unit before I start on the load.

Lines.Approach: He is out of the cab and he is not interested in the weighbridge. The paperwork is probably worse than the weight.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
